# [3.0.0](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/compare/@game-studio/game-in-game@2.1.0...@game-studio/game-in-game@3.0.0) (2026-07-07)


### Bug Fixes

* **bingo-base:** multiple fixes for gig related implementation ([3ec6136](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/commit/3ec6136d39c1833426c0eb3a96f08eaa8cf93bf9))


### Features

* **repo:** added UKI shell connection methods. Added indirect mode for game in game ([d4f1498](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/commit/d4f1498400c17cf78693f176a7944a21882c51be))


### BREAKING CHANGES

* **repo:** launch a game from the gig manager now requires the gameGuid. It is more robust
than the "fuzzy" matchign logic we have for game names/mechanics
* **bingo-base:** GameInGameManager now requires a gigConfigUrl passing explicitly. This is reflected
in the IEndpoints interface
